name: Discovery (STS-96)
about: Discovery (STS-96) (1999-030A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 1999 May 27. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1999 May 29), held fixed
docked to A06140; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
